project(SHELL)

spec2def(ntobjshex.dll ntobjshex.spec)

file(GLOB_RECURSE ntobjshex_rc_deps resources/*.*)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# ntobjshex.dll is all Rust (ntobjshex-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ntobjshex-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# ntobjenum.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ntobjshex-rust/src/ntobjshex/ntobjenum_cpp_h.rs)
# ntobjfolder.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ntobjshex-rust/src/ntobjshex/ntobjfolder_cpp_h.rs)
# ntobjshex.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ntobjshex-rust/src/ntobjshex/ntobjshex_cpp_h.rs)
# regfolder.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/ntobjshex-rust/src/ntobjshex/regfolder_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(ntobjshex_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(ntobjshex_shims PRIVATE uuid wine cpprt atl_classes libadvapi32 libwinmm libole32 liboleaut32 libshlwapi libshell32 libcomctl32 libmsvcrt libgdi32 libuser32 libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(ntobjshex_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(ntobjshex ntobjshex-cargo ntobjshex.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE ntobjshex-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ntobjshex_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
